# gitea_teams (Data Source)

Lists teams within a Gitea organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitea_teams" "example" {
  organisation = "my-org"
}
```
<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organisation` (String) The organisation whose teams to list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `teams` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--teams))

<a id="nestedatt--teams"></a>
### Nested Schema for `teams`

Read-Only:

- `can_create_repos` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (Number)
- `include_all_repositories` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `permission` (String)
- `units` (List of String)
